blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — The Philippine Center for Islam and Democracy (PCID) has congratulated Member of Parliament Abdulraof “Sammy Gambar” Macacua on his election as chief minister of the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) by the region’s first elected Bangsamoro Parliament. In a statement on Tuesday, the PCID called the transition “an important milestone in the Bangsamoro’s journey toward self-governance.” The group said the transition followed “a period of intense political competition and differing perspectives on the region’s leadership and future direction.” READ: Ex-MILF military chief elected first BARMM Chief Minister “The broad acceptance of the September parliamentary election results, […]...
